descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Radiant Blade - Battle Sweep
descriptions.description:
Press  during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Perform a slash followed by a punch at enemies ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Radiant Blade - Battle Sweep
Special Attack: Return to Ashes
descriptions.description:
Press  to activate:
Slash forward at enemies, dealing Fire DMG.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, restore 20% of missing HP when unleashing the slash. The healing effects of Special Attack: Return to Ashes and Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice
descriptions.description:
Hold  to activate:
Enter a charging state, consuming up to 10% of Max HP and gaining 100 Blazing Heart. HP consumption will at most reduce Manato's HP to 30% of Max HP.
Release the button to activate Special Attack: Return to Ashes. If struck during the skill, the slash heals 20% of missing HP. The healing effects of Special Attack: Return to Ashes and Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill or if charging reaches a certain duration, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall
descriptions.description:
While in the Molten Edge state and with sufficient Adrenaline, press  to activate:
Jump up and unleash a falling slash on enemies in front, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Upon activating the skill, restore 33% of Max HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall
Chain Attack: Blazing Eruption
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Hurls his sword forward, then charges the enemy to trigger an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Musou Aratama
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press  to activate:
Jump into the air and deliver a falling slash at enemies in front, followed by an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Lone Shadow - Regroup
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press  to activate:
Slashes and punches enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Lone Shadow - Mountain Stand
descriptions.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press  to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, inflicting massive Daze and dealing Fire DMG.
Gain 75 Blazing Heart upon activating this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Lone Shadow - Breaking Fang
descriptions.description:
Press  after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleash multiple slashes at enemies ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
Repeated presses allow up to 7 extra consecutive slashes.
While chaining slashes, if Manato's HP is above 30%, 2% of Max HP is consumed.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Lone Shadow - Mountain Stand
Assist Follow-Up: Lone Shadow - Breaking Fang

mindscape_cinemas.name: Drill Formations
mindscape_cinemas.description: When the guard boars launch Guard Boars: Spinning Swing!, Lucy recovers 2 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 15s, with each guard boar having its own separate cooldown.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Grassy, eyes right! ...That's left, you idiot!!!"
One command, two directions, three cries of pain, and wails all around.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Little Boar Captain
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Lucy uses a Chain Attack or Ultimate, it grants all squad members and Bangboo, and the guard boars themselves the Cheer On! status for 10s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Without a doubt, Captain Lucy is the best leader of the Calydon Boar Thirens!"
This was Woody's conclusion in the "Sons of Calydon Annual Report."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Ironfist Overseer
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"I just wish Captain Lucy would be more gentle when she's smacking us around."
Woody thought, but didn't dare say it out loud.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Chaos Ball Game
mindscape_cinemas.description: While in the Cheer On! state, allies' CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 10%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2: Rules and ribs are made to be broken.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Wildland Princess
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
She speaks politely to opponents screaming under her bat.
She apologizes to enemies groveling at her feet.
This is the perfect etiquette of a noble lady.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Fierce Fangs of Fire
mindscape_cinemas.description: When another squad member in the Cheer On! state hits an enemy with an EX Special Attack, a guard boar will drop from the sky and cause an explosion, dealing Fire DMG equal to 300% of the guard boar's ATK. This will extend the duration of the Cheer On! buff for all squad members and Bangboo, and for the guard boars themselves by 5s. The duration can increase up to 3 times, with a maximum duration of 30s. Refreshing the Cheer On! state resets the stack count. After the guard boar's explosion, it will launch Guard Boars: Spinning Swing!.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
The little boar Thirens known as the Crimson Mane Guard are always at the forefront of battle!
Though it's hard to tell if, at the moment they're launched by the bat, they feel total despair or just accept their fate.
Brave little boars, leading the charge!

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Lady's Bat
descriptions.description:
Press  to activate:
Strike forward up to 4 times, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
When Lucy uses her fourth Basic Attack, the currently on-field guard boars will launch Guard Boars: Spinning Swing! together.

descriptions.name: Guard Boars: To Arms!
descriptions.description: In combat, the guard boars will randomly use a baseball bat, boxing gloves, or a slingshot to automatically attack enemies, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Guard Boars: Spinning Swing!
descriptions.description: When Lucy uses the fourth Basic Attack, or when she gains the Cheer On! status, the guard boars will whirl their baseball bats in a continuous motion, dealing Physical DMG to nearby enemies. If the attack cannot be executed immediately, the guard boars will remember the required number of times to execute it.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Foul Ball!
descriptions.description:
Press  to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Fearless Boar!
descriptions.description:
Press  during dodge to activate:
Rapidly strikes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Returning Tusk!
descriptions.description:
Press  during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Solid Hit!
descriptions.description:
Press  to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Line Drive. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon hitting enemies or walls, dealing Fire DMG.
Hold  to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Fly Ball. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon landing, dealing Fire DMG.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Home Run!
descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press  to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Line Drive. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon hitting enemies or walls, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Quick Assist.
With enough Energy, hold  to activate:
Recall a guard boar and launch it as a Fly Ball. The guard boar will cause an explosion upon landing, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Quick Assist.

descriptions.name: Cheer On!
descriptions.description: After using EX Special Attack, when a guard boar triggers an explosion, it will apply the Cheer On! status to all squad members and Bangboo, and the guard boars themselves. While under the Cheer On! status, allies' ATK increases by {CAL:13+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*0.8,1,2}% of Lucy's initial ATK + {CAL:40+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*4,1,2}, up to a maximum of 600. The Cheer On! status lasts for 10s when a Line Drive is hit, and 15s when a Fly Ball is hit. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Grand Slam!
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Lucy jumps up and sends a guard boar at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Quick Assist.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Walk-Off Home Run!
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press  to activate:
Launch all guard boars sequentially, dealing massive Fire DMG in a large area to enemies ahead.
While using this skill, other squad members recover 10 energy, and the next character to switch in gains an additional 20 energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers a Quick Assist.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Hit By Pitch!
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press  to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable during the attack.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Safe on Base!
descriptions.description:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press  to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Scored a Run!
descriptions.description:
Press  after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Beat of the Hammer
mindscape_cinemas.description: After the 2nd or 4th hit of Koleda's Basic Attack or her enhanced Basic Attack, quickly use a Special Attack or EX Special Attack to increase the Daze dealt by 15%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2: Her fiery temper is just a facade. In reality, Koleda's thoughts are quite intricate. For example, she knows when to swing her hammer for a more painful strike.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Kinetic Recovery
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Koleda's EX Special Attack hits an enemy, she recovers 60 Energy. Can trigger once every 45s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Koleda believes perfect hammering has its own natural rhythm.
It's like tapping a tambourine, with each hit building up the tempo of the next beat.
Of course, it's hard to say how many taps her "toys" can endure.

mindscape_cinemas.name: "Mind Your Own!"
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
As a qualified "toy," you better not cause trouble when Koleda starts to get a feel for swinging her hammer. Just take the beating.
—After all, what's the point of resisting?

mindscape_cinemas.name: Furnace's Glow
mindscape_cinemas.description: Koleda gains one stack of Charge (max 2 stacks) when consuming Furnace Fire to use her Enhanced Basic Attack. When her Chain Attack: Natural Disaster or Ultimate: Hammerquake hits an enemy, she consumes all stacks of Charge to increase the attack's DMG by 18% per stack.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Koleda feels the flames of war as her hammer swings raise the surrounding temperature.
She's now even more flammable and explosive than Ether.

mindscape_cinemas.name: "You Dare Underestimate Me?"
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2: Koleda cares deeply about her role as a young leader potentially causing others to underestimate Belobog Heavy Industries. To compensate, she consistently trains diligently in secret.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Saturated Blast
mindscape_cinemas.description: When EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate triggers an explosion that hits an enemy, it deals additional DMG equal to 360% of Koleda's ATK.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
There are two types of people that Koleda really hates:
Stupid people, and hopelessly stupid people.
Luckily for her, Belobog always has a good supply of strong Ether explosives — plenty to use on the stupid.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Smash 'n' Bash
descriptions.description:
Press  to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 strikes, dealing Physical DMG.
When Koleda has the Furnace Fire effect, she can launch an enhanced Basic Attack after the 2nd hit, consuming the Furnace Fire effect and dealing massive Fire DMG.
When Koleda and Ben are deployed together, executing an enhanced Basic Attack will trigger a coordinated attack from both, further increasing the move's power;
Koleda is invulnerable during the Basic Attack's 4th hit and enhanced Basic Attack.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Wait 'n' See
descriptions.description:
Press  to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Tremble!
descriptions.description:
Press  during a Dodge to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Don't Look Down on Me
descriptions.description:
Press  during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strikes enemies in front and creates an explosion, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Don't Look Down on Me
Special Attack: Hammer Time
descriptions.description:
Press  to activate:
Strikes enemies in front and triggers an explosion, dealing Fire DMG.
This skill launches faster and triggers an explosion when used after the 2nd or 4th hit of Koleda's Basic Attack or enhanced Basic Attack.
When Koleda and Ben are both in your squad, and this skill is quickly launched after an enhanced Basic Attack, they team up to launch a coordinated attack, further increasing the power of the skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Boiling Furnace
descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press  to activate:
Strikes enemies in front and triggers a powerful explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG. Koleda also gains the Furnace Fire effect.
This skill activates faster and triggers an explosion when used after the 2nd or 4th hit of Koleda's Basic Attack or enhanced Basic Attack.
When Koleda and Ben are both in your squad and this skill is quickly launched after an enhanced Basic Attack, they team up to launch a coordinated attack, further increasing the power of the skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Natural Disaster
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful explosion on enemies in a large area, dealing massive Fire DMG while also obtaining the Furnace Fire effect.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Hammerquake
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press  to activate:
Unleashes a powerful explosion on enemies in a large area in front, dealing massive Fire DMG while also obtaining the Furnace Fire effect.
Koleda and Ben can team up when fighting together to launch a coordinated attack, further increasing the power of the attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Coming Thru!
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press  to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Protective Hammer
descriptions.description:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press  to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Know Thy Self, Know Thy Enemy
mindscape_cinemas.description: When any squad member inflicts an Anomaly on an enemy, Yanagi gains 1 stack of Clarity, lasting 15s, stacking up to 3 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Upon being hit by an enemy attack, Yanagi consumes 1 stack of Clarity to gain invulnerability for 1s. When Yanagi has 1 or more stacks of Clarity, her Anomaly Proficiency increases by 80.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Having the clarity to see your enemy's weakness is like an extra safety net... and it increases your chances at victory."
Yanagi adjusts her glasses, remaining as composed as ever, even when victory is already assured.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Outstanding Adaptability
mindscape_cinemas.description: During her EX Special Attack, the rapid thrust's Electric Anomaly Buildup increases by 20%. Holding down the Special Attack button after a rapid thrust hits an enemy will consume 10 additional Energy to launch another thrust. If Energy is insufficient or the button is released, the attack automatically follows up with the downward attack. When the downward attack hits an enemy suffering an Anomaly and triggers Polarity Disorder, the DMG multiplier increases to 20% of the original Disorder effect. Each additional thrust increases this multiplier by 15%, up to a maximum of 2 extra thrusts.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Yanagi can handle any unfamiliar environment thrown her way."
"I believe in her more than I believe in myself."
— From a martial artist practicing "the cutting of fallen leaves."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Tsukishiro Style Management
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2: Everyone says Section 6 is gathering oddballs and geniuses, with Tsukishiro Yanagi being the only "normal" one. But it's precisely her presence that holds the oddballs and geniuses together.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Chessmaster
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Yanagi inflicts Attribute Anomaly DMG on an enemy, they suffer the Exposed effect, lasting 15s. Attacks on enemies under the Expose effect will have 16% increased PEN Ratio.
mindscape_cinemas.description2: No matter the situation, Tsukishiro Yanagi can rapidly grasp all the information at hand and make the most appropriate decision.

mindscape_cinemas.name: "Other Mother"
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
At present, Tsukishiro Yanagi is the sole designated guardian of Soukaku.
"Soukaku, this is the Chief's riceball, you mustn't eat it... forget it, come here, I'll heat it up for you."
"We'll just buy a similar one for the Chief later."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Inhuman Blood
mindscape_cinemas.description: After a thrust attack during her EX Special Attack, the duration of the Shinrabanshou state increases to 30s. While the state is active, EX Special Attack DMG increases by 20%. The maximum number of times the additional DMG multiplier increase effect for Polarity Disorder in Outstanding Adaptability can be triggered increases to 4, and the Energy cost for the first 4 additional thrust attacks is halved.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Flowing through Tsukishiro Yanagi's veins is blood that isn't entirely her own. This blood once granted her new life in the face of despair, and with it, she gained certain special powers.
"But as you know, something that isn't mine... comes with a price."

mindscape_cinemas.description: The shield value provided by Shield of Firm Resolve and its maximum limit is increased by 30%. When Shield of Firm Resolve ends, the Anomaly Proficiency increase provided by Core Passive: Protector lasts an additional 10s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
When it comes to team missions, Seth is always leading the charge.
"Let me handle the arrests! I scored a 99 in close-quarters arrests, and the only point deducted was because I accidentally sprained the instructor's wrist."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Recklessness of Youth
mindscape_cinemas.description: Upon entering battle, Seth immediately gains 75% Resolve. Hitting an enemy with Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified increases the move's accumulated Electric Anomaly Buildup by 35%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Many criminals make the mistake of underestimating Seth.
It might be his pure, clear eyes or those innocent-looking furry ears and tail. Whatever the reason, everyone who underestimates him eventually pays the price.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Slow Reflexes
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"A skilled officer like you must handle everything on your own, right? No help from others, surely?"
Even after hearing this, Seth remained composed and didn't say a word.
It wasn't until midnight that he suddenly woke up: "Could that guy's comment earlier... have been a dig at me?"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Core Aspiration
mindscape_cinemas.description: The Daze caused by Defensive Assist: Thundershield is increased by 25%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Put aside your foolish notions of good and evil. You can't protect everyone. Sometimes, you have to make a choice."
"This is my choice, and it's the core responsibility of an officer — you're the one who has changed, Brother."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Distant Admiration
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Seth used to deeply admire and respect his older brother. But as you know, "admiration" is the furthest thing from "understanding."
"Someday, I'll become the finest officer... and make him eat his words!"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Idealist

mindscape_cinemas.description2:
To a young person, everything is clear-cut, with a stark contrast between black and white, right and wrong.
There will always be someone who tries to tell him that the world is a murky gray. But is a world where everything is clear-cut and distinct really not worth striving for?

mindscape_cinemas.name: Kindred Flames
mindscape_cinemas.description: Increases the limit of Heat from 100 to 140. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice accumulates an additional 40 Heat. Increases the DMG Multiplier of the Afterburn effect by 100% of Burnice's ATK. Additionally, the accumulated Fire Anomaly Buildup from the Afterburn effect is increased by 25%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Everyone has rough times; it's perfectly normal!"
"Cheer up, Caesar! How about a Nitro-Fuel special? I added a ton of sugar!"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Extra at No Additional Charge
mindscape_cinemas.description: When triggering the Afterburn effect, Thermal Penetration is applied to the enemy, stacking up to 5 times and lasting 6s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When any allied unit in the squad hits the enemy, the attack's PEN Ratio is increased by 4% for each stack of Thermal Penetration, up to a max of 20%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
As the mixologist for the Sons of Calydon, Burnice takes great pleasure in crafting the best Nitro-Fuel drinks in New Eridu for her friends.
Of course, if you happen to be her enemy... you might have the opportunity to try a new and unique flavor too.
"It's a once-in-a-lifetime, absolutely exquisite taste!"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Optimistic by Nature
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"That Burnice, she's always so full of energy! Even right after waking up! I have no idea where she gets all that energy..."
"What's even scarier is that she can get everyone around her to be just as enthusiastic! It's almost like she's some kind of monster!"
"But... I don't really dislike it, to be honest..."
— From a boar manager who wishes to remain unnamed

mindscape_cinemas.name: Ultimate Fuel Supply
mindscape_cinemas.description: When an EX Special Attack or Assist Attack hits an enemy, the move's CRIT Rate increases by 30%. The max flame spray duration of EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot is increased by 1s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"You like the drink I mixed? Thanks! Steeltusk likes them too~ That guy can drink 200 liters in one go!"
"Oh, Steeltusk is our big truck!"
"Wanna try some of its special fuel? It's pretty fiery~"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Dance of Fire and Ice
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
When mixing drinks, ice is a crucial element.
Without an intense chill, the intense heat just doesn't stand out.
"That fusion of fire and ice~ It's truly captivating!"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Static Charge
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Soldier 0 - Anby uses an EX Special Attack to hit an enemy, it triggers the additional DMG from White Thunder 3 times. This effect does not consume any White Thunder stacks.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Please keep my business here a secret from Nicole and the others."
"Alright. Are you sleeping on the couch downstairs or upstairs?"
"...Proxy... Thank you."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Fail-Safe Protocol
mindscape_cinemas.description:
Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT Rate increases by 12%. When she uses her Ultimate, she gains 6 stacks of Thunder's Cry (max 6 stacks). With Thunder's Cry, when using Special Attack: Azure Flash to hit an enemy with White Thunder, it will consume 1 stack of Thunder's Cry instead. Only 1 stack of Thunder's Cry will be consumed when a single use of a skill hits multiple enemies, and consuming Thunder's Cry will still activate the additional DMG from White Thunder.
After activating potential, every 3 stacks of Thunder's Cry consumed, the next Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary will be activated faster.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"What's wrong? You look really tired."
"I'm... fine."
"If you need help, just say the word."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Past Glory
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Anby, we were just talking about you. Are you really okay?"
"I... I'm..."
"If you try to brush it off with 'I'm fine' again, I might not be so kind."
"What does 'not being kind' from you look like, Proxy?"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Silver Reverb
mindscape_cinemas.description: When hitting an enemy marked with Silver Star, Soldier 0 - Anby ignores 12% of the target's Electric RES.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Anby, you just came back from the Hollow. Do you want to take a shower?"
"You go ahead, Proxy. I still need to organize some information..."
"Ha."
"Hmm?"
"Why do I feel like Anby has been living in this house for a long time..."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Director's Cut
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"I get it now. About Anby and Silver Squad..."
"Sorry. I never meant for all of this to become your burden, Proxy."
"So — what movie do you feel like watching tonight?"
"Huh...?"
"Your troubles will never be a burden. See? Normal life can go on as usual."

mindscape_cinemas.name: Prequel Protagonist
mindscape_cinemas.description: Upon triggering 6 instances of White Thunder's additional DMG, an electromagnetic vortex will be generated, dealing 1,000% of Soldier 0 - Anby's ATK as Electric DMG against the target and surrounding enemies. This DMG is considered Aftershock DMG.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
"Well... I should be heading back, Proxy. Thanks for everything you've done for me."
"I know you promised Nicole you wouldn't run away from home again, but isn't this a little unfair to me?
—I miss those days when you and I would watch movies together until dawn."
"Unfair... to you? Well, I'll just have to come up with a way to make up for it."
"Hurry up and think of something."
"Soldier 0, at your service... Huh, huh...?"

mindscape_cinemas.name: Glacial Omen
mindscape_cinemas.description: Upon hitting an enemy with a Swift Scissors strike during Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, the obtained Flash Freeze Charges are increased to 3. Upon hitting an enemy with a Charged Scissors strike during Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, the obtained Flash Freeze Charges are increased to 6. For each Flash Freeze Charge consumed, Ellen's CRIT Rate is increased by 2% for 15s, stacking up to 6 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Chilling winds are an omen of winter, and a signal that Ellen is about to apply for extended leave to hibernate.
Speaking of which, do sharks actually need to hibernate?

mindscape_cinemas.name: Arctic Ocean Predator
mindscape_cinemas.description: The 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming can be directly followed up with EX Special Attack: Sharknami. For each point of Flash Freeze Charge when using an EX Special Attack, the current attack's CRIT DMG is increased by 20%, up to a max of 60%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Despite being freshly stained with red, the massive shears held by Ellen lacked any trace of warmth.
The icy cold stems from her iron-forged instrument, as well as the fear of facing a predator such as herself.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Overtime-Intolerant
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
The whole point of "efficiency" is being able to go home early and sleep.
So strike harder and strike faster.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Endless Hoarfrost
mindscape_cinemas.description: Whenever a squad member Freezes or Stuns an enemy, Ellen gains 6 Flash Freeze Charges and the Quick Charge effect. She also recovers 4 Energy. The Energy recovery effect can trigger once per 10s.
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
A relentless assault of piercing cold. Terrifying monstrosities will learn the beauty and cruelty of winter under Ellen's blade.
But, actually, the endless work that maids have during holidays is far more cruel...

mindscape_cinemas.name: Adequate Sleep
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscape_cinemas.description2:
Except for when in the toughest of battles, Ellen always seems to have that "I can fall asleep at any moment" look.
Many an enemy has met their demise after underestimating Ellen because of it.

mindscape_cinemas.name: The Feast Begins
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Ellen uses an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or gains Quick Charge, her PEN Ratio increases by 20% for 6s. She also gains 1 stack of The Feast Begins, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. With 3 stacks of The Feast Begins, using a Charged Scissors strike during Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush consumes all stacks, increasing the DMG of the current attack by 250%.
mindscape_cinemas.description2: An open wound, a drop of blood. A thrilling hunt, a grand feast. A fragile life, a moment of satisfaction.

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

It inflicts additional instances of Ice DMG against Medium and Large foes.
After the skill, Ellen gains the Quick Charge effect.
Basic Attack: Icy Blade does not affect the branch or form of the original skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

While in the Focused Creation! state, Sunna's Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
While in the Focused Creation! state, Sunna can trigger Cat's Gaze, its damage being calculated using Attack Agent rules. If Cat's Gaze is triggered while Sunna has a Claw Sharpener, the Claw Sharpener is immediately consumed and Cat's Gaze is reapplied to the enemy.

descriptions:
Characters in the Angelic Sync state gain increased ATK, equal to 30% of Sunna's initial ATK, up to a maximum of 525 ATK. When Sunna's initial ATK reaches 1,750, the ATK bonus granted to the entire squad reaches its maximum.
When attacks from Basic Attack: Naughty Cat Spotted, EX Special Attack: Bubblegum Barrage, EX Special Attack: Special Photo Technique, Chain Attack: Don't Mess With the Cat, or Ultimate: Smash It All! hit an enemy, apply Cat's Gaze to the target for 12s. While Sunna is on the field, the duration of Cat's Gaze is continuously refreshed. Some normal enemies affected by Cat's Gaze show reduced aggression toward Sunna.
When Attack or Anomaly characters in the squad continuously land attacks on enemies affected by Cat's Gaze, Cat's Gaze is triggered and removed:
When triggered by an Attack character, deals Agent Attribute DMG equal to 150% ATK to enemies in the area.
When triggered by an Anomaly character, deals Agent Attribute DMG equal to 240% ATK to enemies in the area. This damage is guaranteed to CRIT, and the CRIT DMG is increased by 80%.
Damage dealt by Cat's Gaze is treated as damage dealt by the triggering Agent.
When multiple enemies on the field have Cat's Gaze, only the primary attack target's Cat's Gaze is triggered. Upon triggering, Cat's Gaze is removed from all enemies on the field.
When an enemy is Stunned, the number of attacks required to trigger Cat's Gaze is significantly reduced.

When another character in your squad is an Attack character or shares the same Faction:
When characters inside Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise land attacks on enemies, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% for 40s.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Energy Pulse
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Aria's Basic Attack, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack deals damage to enemies, it ignores 10% of the target's Ether Anomaly Buildup RES. Additionally, when Aria triggers Abloom, it has a chance to trigger a critical hit. The base CRIT Rate is 25%, and CRIT DMG is 25%.. If initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 100, each additional point of Anomaly Mastery increases this effect's CRIT Rate by 0.5%.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Dreambeat
mindscape_cinemas.description: During Moment of Delusion, Aria ignores 12% of enemy DEF when attacking or triggering the Abloom effect.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Dreamer
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

mindscape_cinemas.name: Mechanical Angel
mindscape_cinemas.description: When Aria triggers Abloom, she gains 4 Energy and 70 Decibels. This can trigger once every 10s.

mindscape_cinemas.name: Tears in the Rain
mindscape_cinemas.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

mindscape_cinemas.name: Construct's Dream
mindscape_cinemas.description: Upon entering the battlefield, Aria immediately gains 1,200 Decibels. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger at most once every 180 . After Aria enters Moment of Delusion, she will not exit it, and Enhanced Charged Attacks deal 30% increased Ether DMG. While in Moment of Delusion, when an enemy on the field enters an Anomaly state, Aria gains 1 stacks of All-Out Support. This effect can occur once every 6s.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Sweet Beat
descriptions.description:
Press  to activate:
Launches up to four consecutive attacks forward, dealing Ether DMG.
If the fourth hit lands, 1 Support Energy is generated on the field after the attack ends.

descriptions.name: Charged Attack: Perfect Pitch
descriptions.description:
Hold  to activte:
Aria enters a charging state and can charge up to three stages. Releasing  or reaching the maximum charge time causes Aria to unleash a powerful downward attack forward based on the current charge stage, dealing massive Ether DMG.
If Support Energy is nearby while Aria is charging, she will absorb it. Each Support Energy absorbed immediately increases the charge level by 1 and grants 1 stack of a buff: the next charged attack increases Anomaly Buildup by 10%. This buff can stack up to 2 times and is removed after the charged attack ends.
After the fourth hit of her Basic Attack, Special Attack: Full-Sugar Beats - No Ice, EX Special Attack, Lv. 3 Charged Attack, Quick Assist, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, if there are more than 2 Support Energy nearby, hold  to instantly unleash a Lv. 3 Charged Attack.
While charging, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased and damage taken is reduced by 40%. Character is invulnerable during the charge attack.

descriptions.name: Dodge: On-Beat Precision
descriptions.description:
Press  to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
If activated during a Basic Attack, this action does not reset the Basic Attack sequence.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Silky-Smooth Combo
descriptions.description:
Press  during a dodge to activate:
Flies forward with a swift slashing attack, dealing Ether DMG.
If activated during a Basic Attack, this action does not reset the Basic Attack sequence.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter:
descriptions.description:
Press  during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash against the target, dealing Ether DMG.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the third hit of a Basic Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Full-Sugar Beats
descriptions.description:
Press  to activate:
Delivers a forward kick, dealing Ether DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Full-Sugar Beats - No Ice
descriptions.description:
After the fourth hit of her Basic Attack, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, press  to activate:
Delivers a forward kick, dealing Ether DMG. If the attack hits an enemy, 1 Support Energy is generated on the field after the attack ends.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Fall into Delusion
descriptions.description:
With enough energy, press  to activate:
Delivers a powerful forward kick followed by a sonic wave attack, dealing Ether DMG. If the attack hits an enemy, 3 Support Energy are generated on the field after the attack ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Instantly Hooked
descriptions.description:
After launching EX Special Attack: Fall into Delusion, and with enough Energy, press  to activate:
Performs a powerful downward attack in front, dealing Ether DMG. If the attack hits an enemy, 3 Support Energy are generated on the field after the attack ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Full-Sugar Beats - No Ice
EX Special Attack: Fall into Delusion
Chain Attack: Dream Collab
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches a series of attacks forward, dealing massive Ether DMG. 4 Support Energy are generated on the field on skill activation.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: 100% Energy
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press  to activate:
Releases all her power, entering Moment of Delusion, and fires multiple powerful shots at the target, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Upon entering Moment of Delusion, Aria gains 3 stacks of All-Out Support and activates Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise. While Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise is active, all squad members gain an additional 50 ATK for 30s. Re-activating Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise will first cancel any existing instance of Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise.
While Aria is charging, if she has All-Out Support, stacks of All-Out Support are consumed first to charge. Each stack of All-Out Support consumed increases the charge level by 2.
Upon entering Moment of Delusion, if Aria already has All-Out Support, all remaining stacks of All-Out Support are first converted into Support Energy and generated on the field. Each stack of All-Out Support is converted into 2 Support Energy.
Moment of Delusion lasts for up to 15s. During Moment of Delusion, Aria's Lv. 3 Charged Attack is upgraded to an enhanced version.
When exiting Moment of Delusion, if Aria has All-Out Support, all remaining stacks of All-Out Support are converted into Support Energy and generated on the field. Each stack of All-Out Support is converted into 2 Support Energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Shattered Fantasy
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press  to activate:
Delivers a powerful slash to the target, dealing Ether DMG.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the third hit of a Basic Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Clutch Save
descriptions.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press  to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Song Encore
descriptions.description:
Press  after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleashes a powerful series of slashes on the target, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
